configurations.name: Expo: iOS Simulator (Local)
configurations.command: zsh -i -c 'cp .env.local .env && nvm use 20 && bunx expo run:ios'

configurations.name: Expo: iOS Simulator (Dev)
configurations.command: zsh -i -c 'cp .env.dev .env && nvm use 20 && bunx expo run:ios'

configurations.name: Expo: Android Emulator (Local)
configurations.command: zsh -i -c 'cp .env.local .env && nvm use 20 && bunx expo run:android --clear'

configurations.name: Expo: Android Emulator (Dev)
configurations.command: zsh -i -c 'cp .env.dev .env && nvm use 20 && bunx expo run:android --clear'
